summary: Normalizes a 3-component float vector with a squared-length threshold. Computes the squared length of input a2; when it is at least the global threshold dword_8D6000, computes a Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal square root and scales each input component into the output a1; otherwise writes a zero vector to a1. Returns a1.

local_names.v5: squared length of the input vector
local_names.v7: Newton-Raphson refinement scale applied to every component

operations.description: Compute the squared length v5 = a2[0]*a2[0] + a2[1]*a2[1] + a2[2]*a2[2]
Normalization branch is taken only when the squared length v5 is greater than or equal to the global threshold dword_8D6000; otherwise the zero-vector branch is taken
Compute v6 = 1.0 / fsqrt(v5), the reciprocal square root of the squared length
Newton-Raphson refinement: v7 = dword_8D6004 * v6 * (dword_8D6008 - v5 * v6 * v6)
Scale each input component by v7 into the output vector: a1[0] = v7*a2[0], a1[1] = v7*a2[1], a1[2] = v7*a2[2]
Threshold-fail branch: write 0.0 to all three output components a1[0], a1[1], a1[2]
Return the output vector pointer a1
